description: Lunar Relic is an educational storytelling project exploring NASA's abandoned spacecraft, rovers, landers, and scientific equipment across the Moon and Mars.
summary: Ghosts of Space is a project about how objects and equipments humans left behind on the Moon and Mars after their missions. We will explore some of  these objects, explain what they were useful for, and share the historic accomplishments behind them. We aim to exhibit that even when a space mission ends, the forgotten machines left behind can still tell us stories about space exploration and how far we've come.
details:
Ghosts of Space is an educational website that explores human-made objects left behind on the Moon and Mars. It explains their purpose, history, and contribution to space exploration. Our goal is to raise awareness of these objects and their scientific and historical importance.

We developed the website using HTML, CSS, and JavaScript, with a computer and text editor. GitHub Pages was used to publish it online.

Our project is creative because it focuses on the often-overlooked remains of space missions rather than just rockets and astronauts. During development, we considered historical accuracy, educational value, accessibility, and clear organization. We hope to inspire curiosity about space exploration and encourage more responsible future missions.
